narrative.northStar: Nhịp hàng tươi, trong một tầm nhìn
narrative.overview: Bright operational canvas with a forest navigation rail, scoped store network, and concise inventory table. A clearly labelled offline schematic presents route order without claiming road or GPS accuracy.
keyCharacteristics: Forest navigation with authored SVG icons
Explicit separation of demonstration and backend records
dos: Do keep task status, actor, actual quantity and evidence visible.
Do expose data provenance and estimated-route limitations.
donts: Don't cover active controls with toast overlays.
Don't fabricate business metrics, customers or AI confidence.
Don't replace the operational interface with marketing decoration.
